pass_marks.P1: Pooled revenue WAPE over archetypes A-F is at or below 25% (MODEL.md monitoring threshold).
pass_marks.P2: Pooled revenue bias over archetypes A-F is within +/-10% (MODEL.md monitoring threshold).
pass_marks.P3: For each archetype A-F, the simulation's WAPE is at most 1.5 x the oracle WAPE + the method's systematic WAPE + 1 point (the noise any method faces, plus the method's known built-in error, plus estimation noise from a 3-month level).
pass_marks.P4: For each archetype A-F, the simulation's bias is within 3 points of the method's systematic bias (expected below).
pass_marks.P5: The simulation beats the naive forecast ('next month = last complete month') on WAPE for at least 60% of businesses A-F.
pass_marks.P6: For at least 90% of businesses A-F, actual 6-month revenue lies within the simulation's low-high revenue range (6-month forecast x (1 -/+ the revenue swing used for the low and high cases)).
pass_marks.P7: Confidence is informative: mean WAPE of 'high' confidence runs is lower than mean WAPE of 'medium' and 'low' runs together.
pass_marks.G: Sudden drop (G) is a stress case the method cannot know about. Expected: WAPE above archetype A and bias positive (forecasts too high), because two of the three months in the level are after the drop and one before. Not a pass mark.

scenario_expectations.S1: Given the TRUE inputs (as an owner who knows them would enter them), the simulation's verdict equals the true verdict in 100% of cases and its 12-month profit is within 0.1% of the true figure.
scenario_expectations.S2: With standard figures instead, the simulation's verdict equals the expected verdict below in 100% of cases (it behaves as specified), and it agrees with the TRUE verdict in about the share predicted below.
scenario_expectations.S3: Where the standard-figure verdict is wrong, the simulation flags it as 'not robust' whenever the true input lies inside the range it tests (sensitivity 0.5-2.0; on-costs 10-25%). Expected: at least 90% of such wrong verdicts are flagged.
